reason: I pick my nail artist by their work, and this is a brand-new business I've never seen a single set from. ₱1,800 is more than I'd pay at the mall for gel art, and I'm not paying that on a stranger's word when Shopee press-ons look fine for a fraction of it.
objection: I don't know if the artist is actually good. No portfolio, no reviews, no tagged clients on IG or TikTok, and I'm letting someone into my house to do detailed art I'll be stuck with for three weeks.
would_change_my_mind: A real Instagram or TikTok portfolio with close-up videos of their nail art and tagged clients from around Cainta, plus an intro price for a first set.
